question: Should this maintainer-owned umbrella remain open until the three Wave 1 type-contract PRs land or be narrowed after maintainers review the slices?
rationale: The issue is protected by the maintainer label, has an assigned maintainer, and is already paired with open partial implementation PRs, so automation should not close, split, or queue a competing fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through Slice Review
options.body: Leave the issue open as the coordination item while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100990, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100992, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101012.

options.title: Narrow After Partial Landings
options.body: After any slices land, update the issue body or title so it tracks only the unmerged contract cleanup that remains.

options.title: Defer The Wave
options.body: Pause or close the linked PRs and leave this cleanup for a later maintainer-owned audit wave.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through Slice Review
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open as the coordination item while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100990, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100992, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101012.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the issue and all three linked implementation PRs, making him the clearest decision owner for sequencing.
